messages.subject: Online course - Introduction to R Shiny
messages.subject_clean: Online course - Introduction to R Shiny
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

There are the last 4 seats available for our "Introduction to R Shiny" workshop on January 29-30, 2024 – an immersive online experience for R users.

Course website: https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/shiny/

Join us to discover how Shiny goes beyond being just an R package, evolving into a powerful framework that empowers users to create responsive web applications. Dive deep into fundamental principles and leave confidently equipped to craft sophisticated web apps directly from within R.

Prerequisites:

- Basic proficiency in R required
- Some knowledge of dplyr and ggplot2 beneficial
- Familiarity with RStudio IDE preferable
- No prior knowledge of HTML, CSS, or JavaScript required

Outcomes: After the workshop, you'll:

- Understand Shiny app structure
- Read and comprehend Shiny app code
- Have a solid grasp of Shiny reactivity concepts
- Create and deploy a Shiny app on shinyapps.io <http://shinyapps.io>

For the full list of our courses and workshops, please have a look at: https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/ <https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/shiny/>

Best regards,

Carlo

--------------------

Carlo Pecoraro, Ph.D

Physalia-courses DIRECTOR

in...@physalia-courses.org
